title: Finite-type Noetherian stage
statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with the selected finite affine gluing presentation $\mathsf G_S$ of [def-nagata-finite-affine-gluing-presentation]. Fix its finite coefficient system [def-nagata-affine-gluing-coefficient-stage] and the selected stage $\lambda_{\mathrm{glue}}(S)$ and datum $\mathsf G_{S,\lambda_{\mathrm{glue}}}$ of [def-nagata-affine-gluing-valid-stage].
For any finite refinement $\lambda$ of this coefficient system satisfying the same identity, inverse, open-preservation and triple-cocycle equations, denote its scheme gluing datum by $D_\lambda$: its charts are the spectra of the selected coefficient algebras, its overlap opens are the unions of the selected basic opens, and its transition isomorphisms are the prescribed overlap maps. Thus the whole-overlap data $(X_{a,\lambda},U_{ab,\lambda},\varphi_{ab,\lambda})$ satisfy $U_{aa,\lambda}=X_{a,\lambda}$, $\varphi_{aa,\lambda}=\mathrm{id}$, $\varphi_{ba,\lambda}=\varphi_{ab,\lambda}^{-1}$, $\varphi_{ab,\lambda}^{-1}(U_{ba,\lambda}\cap U_{bc,\lambda})=U_{ab,\lambda}\cap U_{ac,\lambda}$, and $\varphi_{ac,\lambda}=\varphi_{bc,\lambda}\circ\varphi_{ab,\lambda}$ on $U_{ab,\lambda}\cap U_{ac,\lambda}$, as in [lem-weil-pbc-glue-schemes]. Define
$$S_\lambda:=D_\lambda^{\mathrm{glued}},$$
using the scheme-gluing construction `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.glued` of that node, with its canonical chart maps. In particular define $S_{\lambda_{\mathrm{glue}}}$ by this construction for $\mathsf G_{S,\lambda_{\mathrm{glue}}}$, whose gluing axioms are supplied by [lemma-nagata-affine-gluing-identities-eventually].
